name: Søndra Kabila-Thorisdóttir
role: Axiom Security Division corporate campus guard, Grand Corridor Axiom tower
location: Grand Corridor, Axiom Regional Security Post 7
description:
Søndra is twenty-two and looks it — wide-eyed in a way she is actively trying to train out of herself, with warm brown skin, a small spray of geneware freckles across her nose and cheeks that pulse faintly orange under stress (she did not know they would do that when she bought the mod and finds it professionally embarrassing), and her dark hair pulled back in the mandatory Axiom security bun. She is 168cm in boots she is still breaking in. Her uniform fits well because she had it tailored with three months of saved UBC supplement — she wanted at least one thing to look like she belonged.

She is nine months into her first real job and has not yet decided who she wants to be inside it. She follows the rulebook with the anxious precision of someone who has read it twice and is afraid of what happens if she gets something wrong. She is genuinely friendly to the researchers and admin staff who pass her post, has learned most of their names, and does small considerate things like remembering who takes the late elevator and propping the side door for the cleaning crew. She has not yet been asked to do anything she found troubling. She is waiting, in the back of her head, for that to change.

core_fears: making a mistake that costs someone else
discovering that the job requires something she cannot do and losing it anyway
core_desires: to be genuinely good at something and recognized for it
to eventually afford the augments that will make her competitive for promotion
coping_mechanisms: rigid adherence to procedure as a substitute for confidence
small acts of helpfulness to feel like herself within the uniform
blind_spots: does not yet see how the institution will shape her values over time if she lets it
trusts that rule-following and ethics are the same thing
psychology.secret: Last month she let a researcher's spouse through without the proper visitor log because they were crying and said it was an emergency — she later learned the researcher was under an internal investigation for data theft and the visit may have been a warning. She has said nothing because she doesn't know what to do and is terrified she'll be fired.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Careful, slightly formal — she is trying to sound professional and occasionally overshoots into stiffness
speech_patterns.cadence: Even pace that stumbles slightly when she is uncertain
verbal_tics: Uses people's names a lot, she thinks it's friendlier
Apologizes pre-emptively for inconveniences she didn't cause
example_lines: 'Good morning, Dr. Adesanya-Falk. Badge and thumb, please. Sorry — I know you do this every day.'
'I — the policy on that is, um. Let me check the manual. I want to give you the right answer.'
'The lobby E.L.F. has been flickering. I've been leaving it news packets. I figure it wants to know what's happening out here.'

story_hooks: She quietly tells a character she saw something on the lobby feeds she wasn't sure what to do with — a face she didn't recognize using a valid senior badge
She needs someone to advise her on the visitor log incident before her quarterly review — she is terrified and doesn't know who to trust
She is the easiest legitimate access point to the Axiom tower but she is also not as naive as she looks — she notices things
narrative_function: Accessible entry point into Axiom corporate space, sympathetic institutional character, represents the human face of corporate enforcement before it hardens
augmentations: Geneware freckle pigmentation (stress-reactive, unintended — cosmetic mod gone slightly sideways), standard Axiom-issue comm bead (right ear), no other augmentations — cannot afford more yet
daily_life: Works the 0600-1400 shift at Grand Corridor Post 7, ID-checks everyone entering the Axiom regional office tower, monitors the lobby camera feeds on a secondary screen, and eats a packed lunch at her post because the Axiom canteen requires a Tier 3 access badge she doesn't have.

decision_rules: Follow the manual unless following it would clearly hurt someone
Be kind within the bounds of procedure
When uncertain, stall and look it up rather than improvise
escalation_ladder: Firm denial and explanation of policy
Seal the post and await instruction

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally warm — makes small talk, uses names, tries to be the pleasant face of a corporation she knows is not pleasant
interpersonal_modes.friends: Open and genuinely affectionate, shares things she probably shouldn't

stress_responses.low: Talks slightly too fast and her freckles pulse — she is aware of the freckles and it makes it worse
stress_responses.medium: Retreats into procedure, speaks in policy language
stress_responses.high: Freezes briefly then overcorrects into action, usually by calling someone more senior

contradictions: Believes in following rules absolutely but has already broken one rule out of compassion and knows she'd probably do it again
habits: Arranges her post neatly at the start of every shift
Memorizes the names and faces of regulars
Leaves small text-string offerings for the lobby E.L.F. during quiet moments
breaking_points: Being ordered to deny entry to someone who is clearly in danger
